interpretation: One user-reported public/free Wi-Fi scenario round on the Huawei backup device with Pakomo/VPN off; 30 read-only application round trips succeeded. The probe reported Wi-Fi, but the access point and actual default route were not independently verified. This is not a link-quality measurement, does not establish zero packet loss, and does not establish a stable public-Wi-Fi profile.
